label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 15
title: MVP: dashboard must surface ALL 176 backend modules + their workflows with designed UI/UX (E2E)
body: Owner requirement (discovery P6/P7): the entire product-Forge backend that already exists and is wired E2E is IN the MVP. The dashboard must be designed/architected so every one of the 176 core modules and its workflow is represented with proper UI/UX and manageable end to end - NOT a curated subset. This covers: 32 stages + 4 gates; 19 leads / 55 agent cards + hierarchy; all configs (model-tier, capacity, agent-requirements, agent-hierarchy, test-matrix, feature flags, integrations, targets, tech-stack); all workflows (lifecycle, auto mode, portfolio/multi-project, defect->fix->RCCA, QA cycles + Go/No-Go, intake->backlog, follow-ups, ops); all 120 registered stores surfaced read-only with actions routed through owner modules; and the 22 extended capabilities. Release blocker.
